parameters.name: BackupGatewayId
parameters.description: The ID of the backup gateway used for downloading backup sets.

parameters.name: BackupPlanId
parameters.description: The ID of the backup plan. Call the [DescribeBackupPlanList](~~2869825~~) operation to query the backup plan ID.

parameters.name: BackupSetDownloadDir
parameters.description: The server directory for downloading backup sets.

parameters.name: BackupSetDownloadTargetType
parameters.description:
The target type for downloading backup sets.
> Default value: agent, which indicates that a backup gateway is installed. Currently, only this value is supported.

parameters.name: BackupSetDownloadTargetTypeLocation
parameters.description:
The target directory type for downloading backup sets. This parameter is required if automatic download is enabled. Valid values:
- local
- nas
- ftp
- minio

> Default value: local.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request and prevent repeated submissions.

parameters.name: FullDataFormat
parameters.description:
The format of the full data in the backup set to download. Valid values:
- Native
- SQL
- CSV
- JSON

> Default value: CSV.

parameters.name: IncrementDataFormat
parameters.description:
The format of the incremental data in the backup set to download. Valid values:
- Native
- SQL
- CSV
- JSON

> Default value: Native.

parameters.name: OpenAutoDownload
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable automatic download. Default value: false.
